confirmedFindings.title: Unbounded In-Memory Webhook Retry Queue
confirmedFindings.body: The retry queue pushes failed webhook payloads into memory without verifying maximum queue length or eviction policy, leading to Node.js V8 heap exhaustion if external subscriber endpoints experience prolonged outages.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Restore bounded buffer checks with FIFO eviction or dead-letter queue persistence.
